entries.description: A2A discovery surface for broad tool/API/provider discovery, natural-language procurement previews, and five commercially cleared open-source x402 decision packets.
Stateless MCP 2026-07-28 discovery/intake adapter. It never settles money; canonical payment remains HTTP x402.
Five $0.01 native-USDC Base-mainnet commercially cleared open-source stack decisions with request/authority/packet binding, hard caps and emergency disable.

Two independently gated Base-USDC x402 utility products: low-cost short-form AI inference and an optional read-only spendable-goods catalog route. The spend router remains disabled until official provider access is configured and never buys or custodies goods.
Self-owned x402 discovery manifest; Bazaar metadata is also declared on live 402 challenges.
